# Use custom code in templates

Source : https://learn.sweego.io/docs/templates/use_code_in_template

> You can add custom HTML code to your templates using the left panel.

You can add custom HTML code to your templates using the left panel.

To do this, simply drag and drop the 'Code' element into your email.

Double-click on the new block to start adding your custom HTML.

![tempplate](undefined)

Note: The custom HTML code you add won’t render visually in the email builder, but it will be visible when you send a test email.
